page_title: LLM local : quel modèle tourne sur votre machine ? | QuelLLM.fr

sources.entry: QuelLLM - Browser-based calculator and configurator for comparing local AI models against available hardware; results are estimates and the tool does not infer responses. #free #productivity

summary.name: QuelLLM
summary.one_liner: QuelLLM.fr is a French-language site with a free configurator that estimates which open-weight local LLMs run on a given PC or Mac, plus guides for Ollama and LM Studio.
keywords: which llm runs on my pc
which llm runs on my mac
use_cases: Check which open-weight LLMs fit in your GPU or Mac memory
Compare VRAM needs by quantization before downloading a model
Install Ollama or LM Studio and run a first local chat
Pick hardware for a local AI workstation or home server
Set up a private on-premise AI coding assistant
Learn local RAG to chat with your own documents
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes a French-language catalogue of open-weight LLMs that can run locally, listing VRAM needed per quantization, estimated speed and use cases, with French models highlighted. A browser-based configurator matches models to hardware, and the listing describes its results as estimates. The site hosts 385+ tutorials for Windows, macOS and Linux covering installation, RAG and fine-tuning, and it has hardware pages per GPU and Mac model. Some articles mention benchmarks measured on the author's own test units, and one review notes a machine supplied free by GIGABYTE.
notable: Browser-based configurator that matches open-weight LLMs against PC or Mac hardware, with VRAM by quantization
385+ French-language tutorials on Ollama and LM Studio, with the test setup stated per guide
Per-GPU and per-Mac hardware guides (RTX 3060 to 5090, Mac mini M4, Mac Studio)
caveats: Configurator results are estimates, not measured performance
Some kits and guides are presented as paid products; the page does not state prices
